messages.subject: Add annotation
parts:
Hi everyone,

I run all the sequenza jobs with no problems but now, I need to annotate my CNVs and this is beeing a real trouble. Does anyone know how to do this task?

Thanks.

messages.author: bc783355d894fec1
messages.subject: Re: Add annotation
parts: Found the answer... Just use R to convert the file "output_segments.txt" to .bed format and use AnnotSV to annotate!
